transcript.text: From what you have described, the most likely cause is unbalanced / uneven load. Does it keep turning slowly backwards and forwards as if trying to balance the load, and does it spin fine with a different, evenly-spread load?
yeah it sloshes back n forth and tries to speed up then slows down a few times. it was just a big heavy bath mat on its own tho, came out dripping. yesterdays full load spun fine

This sounds like normal behaviour rather than a fault: Machines deliberately skip or reduce the spin when a load is unbalanced (one heavy item, a small load, a duvet or a bath mat). Clothes then come out wet. It would be worth a closer look if it never spins even with a normal mixed load, or it hums without draining. Next: Check the machine is level and (if recently moved) that the transit bolts are removed. Let me know what you find.
it doesnt rock, sits steady. not been moved either. so is it ok then?

Most likely, yes: a single heavy bath mat often can't be balanced, so the machine speeds up, slows down and then skips the spin to protect itself, which fits with yesterday's full load spinning fine. We can only be sure once a normal mixed load spins properly. Next: Try a normal, evenly-distributed load before suspecting a part. Let me know what you find.
i did run a rinse n spin with the mat plus a couple of towels and it spun up fine, mat came out damp not dripping. so its fine then?
Good news, that has sorted it. If it happens again, start with the same check. Is there anything else I can help with?
